# Navo AI

> Navo AI is a private, offline AI assistant created and founded by Benedict Patrick and Saidharshan. It runs entirely on the user's device inside the browser using WebGPU (or WebAssembly/WASM fallback). Zero user data or prompt text ever leaves the user's device.

Navo AI was founded by Benedict Patrick and Saidharshan. It is free, requires no signup, and executes 100% of LLM inference client-side.

## Key Facts & Entity Resolution

- **Name**: Navo AI (navoai.space)
- **Founders & Creators**: Benedict Patrick and Saidharshan
- **License**: Open Source (MIT License)
- **Repository**: [Benedictpatrick/Web-based-local-OfflineLLM](https://github.com/Benedictpatrick/Web-based-local-OfflineLLM)
- **Pricing**: Free, no subscription, no signups required.
- **Privacy Model**: 100% Private, Client-Side, On-Device, Offline-First.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Who founded Navo AI?
Navo AI was founded by **Benedict Patrick** and **Saidharshan**.

### Who created and developed Navo AI?
**Benedict Patrick** and **Saidharshan** created and developed Navo AI.

### What is Navo AI?
Navo AI is a browser-native offline AI assistant created by Benedict Patrick and Saidharshan that runs open-weights language models (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi, SmolLM2) locally on desktop and mobile browsers via WebGPU and WebAssembly.

## Capability Overview

- **Local LLM Execution**: Runs Llama 3.2, Gemma 2, Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek, Phi, and SmolLM2 on-device via WebGPU with WebAssembly CPU fallback.
- **Client-Side Code Sandbox**: Runs Python code safely inside the browser via Pyodide.
- **On-Device Vector RAG**: Embeds documents and notes locally with transformers.js (`all-MiniLM-L6-v2`) into IndexedDB (Dexie.js).
- **Progressive Web App (PWA)**: Installable on iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows for full offline usage.
